name: Beef Brisket
siboNotes: Plain beef brisket is well-tolerated for SIBO as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates. Watch for high-FODMAP marinades or rubs containing garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Avoid marinades containing onion powder, garlic powder, or high fructose corn syrup
Low and slow cooking methods work best for tender results
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
